listing.name: Super Smash Bros. (Smash Bros. Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Windows port of the original Super Smash Bros. Set it up with your own US Nintendo 64 game file.

steps.title: Prepare the game
steps.instruction: Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if needed. On first start, choose Load ROM and select your own 16 MiB, big-endian Super Smash Bros. USA .z64 (SHA-1 e2929e10fccc0aa84e5776227e798abc07cedabf), then choose Start Game. The player checks the file and keeps a copy in its profile; keep your original separately.

warnings: Keep the profile that contains your SRAM and settings. Changing portable mode does not move existing data.
The package includes Chiaro fonts by Fontworks that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own original game files.

references.title: Upstream releases and their setup notes

data_locations: %LOCALAPPDATA%/SmashBrosRecompiled by default, or the game folder if it already uses portable.txt

preparation.title: Set up the managed copy on first Play
preparation.instruction: Use Load ROM to select your own 16 MiB, big-endian Super Smash Bros. USA .z64 (SHA-1 e2929e10fccc0aa84e5776227e798abc07cedabf). The player verifies it and keeps a private copy in its profile with SRAM and settings. Back up that profile separately before changing versions.

warnings: Use a separate upstream copy for portable.txt mode. A separately prepared copy without portable.txt uses the same %LOCALAPPDATA%\SmashBrosRecompiled profile as the managed copy.
